summary: Hardened `/tmp` and `/dev/shm` on node1 with `nosuid,nodev,noexec`. Both remain hardened and usable after a verified node reboot; the Alpine release and kernel were unchanged.
actions_performed: Added persistent tmpfs entries for `/tmp` and `/dev/shm` to `/etc/fstab`.
Applied the hardened mounts live with mode 1777.
Verified execution and device access fail on both mounts.
Rebooted node1 and confirmed services, filesystems, mount options, and read/write access recovered.

evidence.summary: Fstab contains persistent hardened tmpfs entries; kernel mount records and post-reboot functional tests confirm the options.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
